verses.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.pt: Palavra que veio do SENHOR, a Jeremias, dizendo:
verses.en_web: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
verses.en_bbe: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

verses.en: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.pt: Ouvi as palavras deste pacto, e falai aos homens de Judá, e aos moradores de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: “Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to the words of this agreement, and say to the men of Judah and to the people of Jerusalem,

verses.en: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,
verses.pt: Dize-lhes, pois: Assim diz o SENHOR, Deus de Israel: Maldito o homem que não ouvir as palavras deste pacto,
verses.en_web: and say to them, Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Cursed is the man who doesn’t hear the words of this covenant,
verses.en_bbe: The Lord, the God of Israel, has said, Let that man be cursed who does not give ear to the words of this agreement,

verses.en: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:
verses.pt: Que mandei a vossos pais no dia que os tirei da terra do Egito, do forno de ferro, dizendo: Ouvi a minha voz, e as fazei conforme a tudo quanto eu vos mando; então vós sereis meu povo, e eu serei vosso Deus;
verses.en_web: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’ saying, ‘Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;
verses.en_bbe: To the order which I gave your fathers on the day when I took them out of the land of Egypt, out of the oven of iron, saying, Give ear to my voice, and do all the orders I have given you: so you will be my people, and I will be your God:

verses.en: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD.
verses.pt: Para que eu confirme o juramento que fiz a vossos pais, que lhes daria uma terra em que mana leite e mel, tal como hoje.E eu respondi, e disse: Amém, SENHOR!
verses.en_web: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as it is today.” Then answered I, and said, “Amen, Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: So that I may give effect to the oath which I made to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey as at this day. And I said in answer, So be it, O Lord.

verses.en: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
verses.pt: E disse-me o SENHOR: Proclama todas estas palavras nas cidades de Judá e nas ruas de Jerusalém, dizendo: Ouvi as palavras deste pacto, e praticai-as;
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to me, Give out these words in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Give ear to the words of this agreement and do them.

verses.en: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
verses.pt: Porque insistentemente adverti a vossos pais o dia que eu os tirei da terra do Egito até o dia de hoje, repetidamente advertindo, dizendo: Ouvi minha voz.
verses.en_web: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, “Obey my voice.”
verses.en_bbe: For I gave certain witness to your fathers on the day when I took them up out of the land of Egypt, and even to this day, getting up early and witnessing and saying, Give ear to my voice.

verses.en: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.
verses.pt: Porém não ouviram, nem inclinaram seus ouvidos; ao invés disso, seguiram cada um a teimosia de seu coração maligno. Por isso trouxe sobre eles todas as palavras deste pacto, que mandei que cumprissem, mas não cumpriram.
verses.en_web: Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn’t do them.’”
verses.en_bbe: But they gave no attention and did not give ear, but they went on, every man in the pride of his evil heart: so I sent on them all the curses in this agreement, which I gave them orders to keep, but they did not.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.pt: E disse-me o SENHOR: Achou-se conspiração entre os homens de Judá, e entre os moradores de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to me, “A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to me, There is an evil design at work among the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem.

verses.en: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
verses.pt: Voltaram às maldades de seus primeiros pais, que se recusaram a ouvir minhas palavras; ao invés disso, eles seguiram deuses estrangeiros, para lhes servirem; a casa de Israel e a casa de Judá violaram meu pacto, que eu tinha feito com seus pais.
verses.en_web: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
verses.en_bbe: They are turned back to the sins of their fathers, who would not give ear to my words; they have gone after other gods and become their servants: the people of Israel and the people of Judah have not kept the agreement which I made with their fathers.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
verses.pt: Portanto, assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que trarei sobre eles calamidade, da qual não poderão escapar; e clamarão a mim, mas eu não os ouvirei.
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on them, which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to me, but I will not listen to them.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord has said, I will send evil on them, which they will not be able to get away from; and they will send up a cry for help to me, but I will not give ear to them.

verses.en: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
verses.pt: Então as cidades de Judá e os moradores de Jerusalém irão, e clamarão aos deuses a quem queimam incensos; porém de maneira nenhuma poderão os salvar no tempo de sua calamidade.
verses.en_web: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense, but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
verses.en_bbe: Then the towns of Judah and the people of Jerusalem will go crying for help to the gods to whom they have been burning perfumes: but they will give them no salvation in the time of their trouble.

verses.en: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.
verses.pt: Porque teus deuses foram tão numerosos quanto tuas cidades, ó Judá; e tão numerosos quanto tuas ruas, ó Jerusalém, vós pusestes altares da vergonha, altares para queimar incensos a Baal.
verses.en_web: For according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have you set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.’
verses.en_bbe: For the number of your gods is as the number of your towns, O Judah; and for every street in Jerusalem you have put up altars to the Baal for burning perfumes to the Baal.

verses.en: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
verses.pt: Tu, pois, não ores por este povo, nem levantes por eles clamor nem oração; porque eu não ouvirei no dia em que clamarem a mim em meio a calamidade deles.
verses.en_web: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up cry or prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble.
verses.en_bbe: And as for you, make no prayers for this people, send up no cry or prayer for them: for I will not give ear to their cry in the time of their trouble.

verses.en: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
verses.pt: Que direito tem minha amada em minha casa, visto que muitos têm feito tão grandes abominações? Podem carnes “santificadas” te livrar, de modo que te alegras com tua maldade?
verses.en_web: What has my beloved to do in my house, since she has behaved lewdly with many, and the holy flesh has passed from you? When you do evil, then you rejoice.”
verses.en_bbe: About Judah. What have you to do in my house? is it your thought that oaths and holy flesh will get you out of your trouble? will you make yourself safe in this way?

verses.en: The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
verses.pt: O SENHOR chamava o teu nome de Oliveira verde, formosa de belos frutos. Porém agora,à voz de grande tumulto, ele acendeu fogo sobre ela, e seus ramos foram quebrados.
verses.en_web: Yahweh called your name, “A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit.” With the noise of a great roar he has kindled fire on it, and its branches are broken.
verses.en_bbe: You had been named by the Lord, A branching olive-tree, fair with beautiful fruit: with the noise of a great rushing he has put it on fire and its branches are broken.

verses.en: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
verses.pt: Pois o SENHOR dos exércitos, que te plantou, pronunciou calamidade contra ti, por causa da maldade da casa de Israel e da casa de Judá, que fizeram entre si mesmos, para me provocarem à ira queimando incenso a Baal.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord of armies, by whom you were planted, has given his decision for evil against you, because of the evil which the people of Israel and the people of Judah have done, In moving me to wrath by offering perfumes to the Baal.

verses.en: And the LORD hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR me fez saber, e conhecer; então tu me fizeste ver suas ações.
verses.en_web: Yahweh gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord gave me knowledge of it and I saw it: then you made clear to me their doings.

verses.en: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
verses.pt: E eu estava como cordeiro manso, que levam para degolar, pois não entendia que tramavam planos contra mim, dizendo: Destruamos a árvore com seu fruto, e o cortemos da terra dos viventes, e não haja mais lembrança de seu nome.
verses.en_web: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me, saying, “Let us destroy the tree with its fruit, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.”
verses.en_bbe: But I was like a gentle lamb taken to be put to death; I had no thought that they were designing evil against me, saying, Come and let us make trouble his food, cutting him off from the land of the living, so that there may be no more memory of his name.

verses.en: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
verses.pt: Mas, ó SENHOR dos exércitos, justo juiz, que provas os sentimentos e pensamentos, veja eu tua vingança deles; porque a ti mostrei minha causa.
verses.en_web: But, Yahweh of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for to you I have revealed my cause.
verses.en_bbe: But, O Lord of armies, judging in righteousness, testing the thoughts and the heart, let me see your punishment come on them: for I have put my cause before you.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:
verses.pt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR quanto aos homens de Anatote, que buscam matar tua alma, dizendo: Não profetizes em nome do SENHOR, para que não morras por meio de nossas mãos;
verses.en_web: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy in Yahweh’s name, that you not die by our hand;’
verses.en_bbe: So this is what the Lord of armies has said about the men of Anathoth who have made designs against your life, saying, You are not to be a prophet in the name of the Lord, or death will overtake you by our hands:

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
verses.pt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Eis que eu os punirei; os rapazes morrerão a espada; seus filhos e suas filhas morrerão de fome;
verses.en_web: therefore Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Behold, I will punish them. The young men will die by the sword. Their sons and their daughters will die by famine.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord of armies has said, See, I will send punishment on them: the young men will be put to the sword; their sons and their daughters will come to death through need of food:

verses.en: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
verses.pt: E não restará sobrevivente deles, pois eu trarei calamidade sobre os homens de Anatote, no ano em que serão punidos.
verses.en_web: There will be no remnant to them, for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.’”
verses.en_bbe: Not one of them will keep his life, for I will send evil on the men of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.
